Fab access recovery

The installed UE 5.6 Fab plugin exists at [local path], with its UnrealEditor-Fab.dll present. Its descriptor enables it by default, but this project sets DisableEnginePluginsByDefault=true and did not explicitly list Fab. The active Editor log has no Fab plugin mount/startup entry.

Added an explicit enabled Fab entry to ForgeMCPDev.uproject, limited to Editor targets. All previous plugin entries and other descriptor fields compare unchanged. Backup: Saved/FabRecovery_20261016/ForgeMCPDev.before-fab.uproject. JSON parsing and the preservation comparison passed. No native source changed.

This configuration fix requires restarting the Editor. It does not prove live Fab activation, Epic account authentication, network connectivity, entitlement visibility or downloads. Save the active regional city work before restarting. After restart, verify Window > Fab and sign in as needed. Do not delete web caches or reset account state without a demonstrated need.

The user explicitly paused city placement to prioritize Fab. A final guarded checkpoint succeeded before restart: operation 35a8d9f64a03c24810fb22a43f908290, with saved-package file verification recorded in Saved/FabRecovery_20261016/pre_restart_city_checkpoint.json. No city installation or import process remains running. Fab's declared Interchange, EditorDataStorageFeatures, EditorScriptingUtilities and EOSShared plugin descriptors were also found in this engine installation. Restart and live store verification remain pending.
